translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Woshumaappe Haakka
Ta na'aw, ta aad'd'eeda eratetsaa hayzza; ne haytsaa ta akeekaakko yegga.
Yaatooppe, adussa k'ofay new de'ana; ne haasayaykka ne eratetsaa k'onc'c'issana.
Woshumiyaa mac'c'a mishirati ins's'arssaappe eessaa ililuu s'okee; I haasayay oyssaappekka aad'd'i shuggee.
Shin iza wurssetsan godare uutsaadan c'ammaw; laa"u baggan k'ans's'iyaa mashshaadan k'ans's'iyaano;
I gedetuu hayk'k'uwaakko duge biino; I hametay sitti ootsiide, duufuwaa afee.
Iza de'uwaa ogiyaa k'oppukku; I ogetuu geella; shin geella gidiyaawaakka Aa erukku.
Ta naatoo, ha"ikka taani odiyaawaa sisite; taani giyaawaappe kesoppite.
Woshumiyaa mac'c'a mishirati heeraa booppite; I golliyaa penggiyaakko shiik'oppite.
Hewe d'ayooppe, hintte hinttenttu bonchchuwaa haratoo aatsiide immana. Hinttenttu hinttenttu yalagatetsan mek'etsi bayinna asatuwaa kushiyan hayk'k'ana.
Hinttenttu mas'uwaa allaga asatuu akkana. Hintte daaburiide shiishsheeddawe hara asaw gidanawaa.
Wurssetsan hintte ashuunne hintte asatetsay gilk'k'ina, hintte olana.
K'ay hawaadan yaaganita; «Taan timirttiyaa ayaw is's'aaditaashsha! Ta wozanaykka seeraa ayaw kad'eeddeeshsha!
Taani taana tamaarissiyaawanttu odeeddawaa akkabeyikke; taana zoriyaawanttu zoriyaakka hayzzabeykke.
Hewaa diraw, taani Asay shiik'eedda shiik'uwaan, akeekenan kawushshanaw de'ay» yaagana.
Ne machchatiw amaneteedawaa gida; izi s'alala siik'a.
Hara mac'c'aanippe yeletteedda ne naanatuu, new lo"obaa ootsikkino.
Unttunttu neena maaddanaw dic'c'ino; allaga gidoppino.
Hewaa diraw ne machchattina nashetta; yalagatetsan neeni akkeedda ne machchatippe nashechchaa koya.
Lo"iyaa gaaratidaaninne nashechchiyaa gen"atiidan, I d'antsay ubbaa wodekka neena alo; ubbaa wode I siik'uu neena omooddo.
Ta na'aw, woshumiyaa mishirata neena ayaw omoodday? Hara asaa machchato ayaw k'oommay?
Ayaw gooppe, Asay ootsiyaawaa ubbaa Med'inaa Goday be'ee; I hamettiyaa loossuwaa ubbaa s'eellee.
Nagaranchchaa I ootseedda nagaray oyk'k'ee. Aa nagaraa gitii Aa k'achchee.
I bare boozatetsan haleedda; bare huup'iyaa naagibeenna diraw hayk'k'eedda.
